text.p: Datatrend Services Inc said on Wednesday that it will close its Braintree, Mass., warehouse and refurbishment center by June 30 as part of a cost-cutting plan to consolidate activities to its Memphis, Tenn., location.
The Braintree facility's 43 employees were notified last week of the closing, Datatrend said in a statement.

"The company believes that the Memphis location is better suited to perform these services because of its favorable real estate and employment market. It is not anticipated that additional staff will be needed in the Memphis facility in the short term to accommodate the change," the company said.
The company also said it will decide shortly whether or not office and administration functions being performed in Braintree should also be relocated to Memphis.
The company said it would be taking an immaterial charge for the closing and did not disclose the amount.
Datatrend specializing in the refurbishment, distribution and sales of returned and used computer hardware and electronic equipment.
